task: Real GPT-2 layer-0 GELU FFN compact source-structure recovery

blackBoxBoundary.oracle: GCL receives f(vector) for the compact real GPT-2 FFN output slice during recovery
blackBoxBoundary.provenance: Source manifest is used only after recovery to verify exact GPT-2 channel ids, weights, and why-reacts evidence.
blackBoxBoundary.notASurrogateGate: Pass requires recovered atom count and per-source provenance matches, not only output R2.

claimScope.provesIfPasses: GCL can recover explicit GELU atoms from a real GPT-2 layer-0 FFN top-K output-channel slice and map them to exact GPT-2 source channels through provenance verification.
claimScope.doesNotClaim: full GPT-2 FFN extraction, arbitrary 3072-channel recovery, arbitrary tokenizer/model execution, output-only original-neuron identity without source manifest/hooks, or broad SOTA status.
